ordinaryTurns.scope: Real initial walk, wait and forced attack; input through pending output and next read. Generic C field access and pointer-table dispatch are also counted; C malloc includes this runtime's C-stack allocations. Counters are architectural acceptance, not CPU or timing samples.

statusTurns.scope: Source make_confused/make_stunned/reset at declared real command input boundaries, with actual changed-direction RNG. Complete command snapshots, world graph, both ISAAC states/logs, terminal bytes/frames and raw More input match original C. No fabricated map/monster or raw status-field writes. legacyFixture.scope: Preserved isolated-C compatibility factory and controlled foreign world, not evidence that all production branches execute.
